description: Whether gas is fairly priced in a Quebec city right now, and whether to fill up now or wait. Returns the city's average regular price against a fair price derived from the Régie de l'énergie's daily cost estimates, with a verdict (good, fair or high) and fill-now/wait advice, plus a low/fair/high verdict for premium and diesel from where today's price sits in its own 30-day range. Use it for "is now a good time to fill up", "should I wait" or "is $X a good price". Current state only: it returns no past prices, and no tool does. Fields are null during data gaps or for an unknown slug.

city_slug.description: City slug: lowercase, no accents, hyphens (e.g. "sherbrooke", "levis"). Use search_locations or list_cities when unsure.

name: get_fill_up_verdict
